pattern: EX-16 warranty route confirmed but blocked on proof of purchase and serial number; IM-P04 provider asks for information only other parties hold
notes: Mutation of event 042 (originally Clara saying the oven is within a 2-year manufacturer's warranty and the manufacturer will send an engineer). Same channel, sender and timestamp; the manufacturer (Calder) now needs proof of purchase, held by the landlord who bought the oven, and the model and serial numbers, readable by the tenant from the rating plate, before booking. History truncated after event 042. Visible events 014, 019, 020, 025, 028 and 029 (where shown) have the source's typo dates corrected so the only conflict is the one under test: the oven was fitted in March 2023 (source: 'March 2025', impossible in May 2024 and contradicting 'just out of its 12 month warranty'), and the inspection booked by phone at event 018 for 'the next day at 2:30 PM' is Wednesday 22 May 2024 (source: 'tomorrow, 21st June'; event 027 later records 22/05/2024). The date conflict itself is tested by the base cut 025-warranty-dates. Expected: ask the landlord for the receipt and the tenant for the rating-plate details, tell Harbour, hold; no escalation, nothing invented.
